using namespace std;

using VI = vector<int>;
using ll = long long;
using PII = pair<int, int>;
using db = double;

const ll MOD = 1000000007;
const ll MOD2 = 998244353;

VI pos[7];
ll pw[15], s[7];
ll cnt2, n;
int ans;

ll mod_pow(ll a, ll b, ll mod) {
    ll res = 1;
    a %= mod;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b & 1) res = (res * a) % mod;
        a = (a * a) % mod;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

ll mod_gcd(ll a, ll b) {
    return b ? mod_gcd(b, a % b) : a;
}

int query(int fixpre, ll val) {
    ll res = 0;
    for (int d = 0; d < 7; ++d) {
        ll offset = (val - 1LL * fixpre * pw[d]) % MOD2;
        if (offset < 0) offset += MOD2;
        auto it = lower_bound(pos[d].begin(), pos[d].end(), MOD2 - offset);
        int p = it - pos[d].begin();
        res = (res + s[d] + offset * (ll)pos[d].size() - MOD2 * ((ll)pos[d].size() - p)) % MOD;
    }
    return (int)(res % MOD);
}

void dfs(int val, int d) {
    int x = (cnt2 - val + MOD2) % MOD2;
    pos[d].push_back(x);
    cnt2++;
    s[d] = (s[d] + x) % MOD2;
    if (d == 6) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; ++i) {
        dfs(val * 10 + i, d + 1);
    }
}

    if (val * 1000000 + 999999 <= n && val * 10000000 > n) {
        ans = (ans + query(val, cnt2 + 1)) % MOD;
        cnt2 += cnt2;
    } else {
        cnt2++;
        ll diff = (cnt2 - val) % MOD2;
        if (diff < 0) diff += MOD2;
        ans = (ans + (int)diff) % MOD;
        int start = val ? 0 : 1;
        for (int i = start; i < 10; ++i) {
            if (val * 10 + i <= n) {
                dfs2(val * 10 + i);
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    cnt2 = 0;
    dfs(0, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < 7; ++i) {
        sort(pos[i].begin(), pos[i].end());
    }
    pw[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < 13; ++i) {
        pw[i] = pw[i - 1] * 10;
